properties.label: Copy and lamina split
properties.text: Place a compact left-aligned promise and install-sized action beside a tall isometric stack, retaining architectural void, full-height column rails and a small external read-head with a leader line.

properties.label: Neutral sans with mono specimens
properties.text: Set the headline in a large neutral sans and the specimen labels in tiny monospace.

properties.label: Graphite and cool white palette
properties.text: Use graphite #0a0c10, cool white faces, near-black undersides and fine blue dimensions.

properties.label: Isometric reference laminae
properties.text: Construct the object as thin reference strata with visible thickness, short edge highlights, occluded gaps and a sharp white top face.

properties.label: Diagonal ground light
properties.text: Cast the light diagonally across the ground plane.

properties.label: Travelling read-head
properties.text: Move one discrete read-head between strata while its leader, index, kind and swatch update together; reduced motion freezes one complete reading.

properties.label: Dated specimen truth
properties.text: Present the numbers as an explicitly dated specimen rather than a current library count, and do not flatten the stack into a generic dashboard.

properties.label: Scale and reflow acceptance
properties.text: Judge the stack at thumbnail and detail scale. On mobile place it below the copy with the full base and labels visible, and keep the action clear of its top.
